# `try_make_timestamp_ntz`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
try_make_timestamp_ntz(year, month, day, hour, min, sec)
```

Try to create local date-time from year, month, day, hour, min, sec fields. The function returns NULL on invalid inputs.

try_make_timestamp_ntz(date, time) - Create a local date-time from date and time fields.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 6 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT try_make_timestamp_ntz(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887);
```

Result:

```text
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
SELECT try_make_timestamp_ntz(2019, 6, 30, 23, 59, 60);
```

Result:

```text
2019-07-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
SELECT try_make_timestamp_ntz(null, 7, 22, 15, 30, 0);
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```

```sql
SELECT try_make_timestamp_ntz(2024, 13, 22, 15, 30, 0);
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```

```sql
SELECT try_make_timestamp_ntz(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887');
```

Result:

```text
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```
